definition: the time between parents and their children
description: A sunny rustic kitchen with wooden beams and copper pans on the wall. Two women who look alike, one young and one about thirty years older, stand side by side in white tops and rust-coloured trousers. Each flips a pancake high into the air with a black frying pan, catches it again, and both laugh and look at each other before the younger one turns away. On the wooden island are a bowl of batter, a jar of honey, a stack of pancakes and a dish of oranges, and light comes through a window with an olive tree outside.

de.answer: Zwei Generationen von Frauen wenden Pfannkuchen.
de.question: Wer wendet Pfannkuchen?
